$comment: Platform-leg manifest for @universe/mycelium entry points (INFRA-3517). Declares, per package.json exports subpath, whether the web and native implementations are real, deliberate throwing stubs, or missing entirely. universe-custom/no-throwing-stub-imports (config/oxlint-plugins/) is generated from this file: web-bundled projects may not import entries whose web leg throws/is missing, native-reachable projects may not import entries whose native leg throws/is missing. Statuses: 'real' (working implementation), 'throws' (deliberate throwing stub), 'missing' (no leg for that platform — the bundler resolves the other platform's code). Optional webNote/nativeNote strings are appended to the lint message. namedExports scopes a status to individual named exports of an otherwise-real entry. Keep aligned with package.json exports — config/oxlint-plugins/mycelium-platform-legs.test.ts fails when an entry point is added or removed without a matching row here.

./testing.nativeNote: MyceliumThemeTestWrapper toggles a document.documentElement class, a web-only theming mechanism; it no-ops (guarded by a `typeof document` check) rather than throwing when rendered under RN's test environment.

BackArrow.nativeNote: Web-only holdout (INFRA-3285): the RTL check reads document.documentElement.dir.

CloseIconWithHover.nativeNote: Web-only holdout (INFRA-3285): renders the div-based Flex with DOM mouse/keyboard hover handlers.

OSDynamicCloudIcon.nativeNote: Web-only holdout (INFRA-3285): the web port is a GoogleDrive passthrough of the legacy per-OS icon (iOS branch unported).

Unitag.nativeNote: Web-only holdout (INFRA-3285): renders and watches the root class via MutationObserver.

./logos.nativeNote: mycelium logos have no native leg: the sole logo GoogleChromeLogo renders raw lowercase SVG tags (<defs>, <linearGradient>, <stop>, <circle>, <path>) that react-native-svg cannot draw. Use ui/src logos in native-reachable code.

./logos/*.nativeNote: mycelium logos have no native leg: the sole logo GoogleChromeLogo renders raw lowercase SVG tags (<defs>, <linearGradient>, <stop>, <circle>, <path>) that react-native-svg cannot draw. Use ui/src logos in native-reachable code.

./assets/*.nativeNote: A direct .svg import resolves to a react-native-svg-transformer component on native but a URL on web (apps/web's svg-import-fix plugin). Import the generated icon/logo component instead.

./components.nativeNote: The components barrel is web-only DOM (Radix/cva); only UniversalList has native legs and it is exported from the package root.

./floating-overlay.webNote: Permanent by design (INFRA-2965): web floating UI rides the Base UI engine — use the popover-compat / shadcn recipes instead.

./shadcn.nativeNote: shadcn recipes are web-only DOM (Radix); there is no native leg.

./portal.nativeNote: The native leg is real code but throws until a PortalProvider is mounted, and no native app mounts one yet (INFRA-2958). Native portals keep the legacy ui/src/components/portal/Portal implementation until that provider lands; this leg renders through the same primitive (@rn-primitives/portal into a provider-owned host), so repointing them is an import swap rather than a behavior change.

./tokens.nativeNote: `fonts` is platform-resolved (src/font-tokens.{ts,web.ts,native.ts}): the native leg applies ui's +1px adjustedSize ramp and names the real RN font family. Every other family here is platform-invariant. Recorded because these statuses cannot express 'resolves but returns the wrong platform's values'. Device columns (iOS and Android): packages/tailwind/src/parity/fonts-token/native-parity.test.ts.
